draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.33, the 44th-best grade among 257 2026 draftees and 5th of 20 at DE. He went 55th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Matthew Judon. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: his final season (2025) ranked 2nd in sacks among the 20 DEs in his class with stats.
